import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

research = data['research_milestones']['data']
industry = data['industry_milestones']['data']
regulation = data['regulation_milestones']['data']
investment = data['ai_investment']['data']

def parse_date(d):
    parts = d.split('-')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return datetime(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), 15)
    return datetime(int(parts[0]), 1, 1)

# Editorial color palette
colors = {
    'Research': '#2563EB',
    'Industry': '#E11D48',
    'Regulation': '#059669',
    'investment_fill': '#F59E0B',
    'investment_line': '#D97706',
    'bg': '#FAFAF9',
    'grid': '#E7E5E4',
    'text': '#1C1917',
    'subtext': '#57534E',
    'chatgpt_line': '#7C3AED',
}

sig_sizes = {'critical': 11, 'high': 7.5, 'medium': 5}
sig_markers = {'critical': 'D', 'high': 'o', 'medium': 'o'}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 14), facecolor=colors['bg'])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(5, 1, height_ratios=[1.15, 1.15, 1.15, 0.75, 0.12],
                      hspace=0.08, left=0.06, right=0.94, top=0.89, bottom=0.06)

ax_research = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax_industry = fig.add_subplot(gs[1], sharex=ax_research)
ax_regulation = fig.add_subplot(gs[2], sharex=ax_research)
ax_invest = fig.add_subplot(gs[3], sharex=ax_research)

axes_tracks = [ax_research, ax_industry, ax_regulation]
track_data = [
    ('Research', research, colors['Research']),
    ('Industry', industry, colors['Industry']),
    ('Regulation', regulation, colors['Regulation']),
]

start_date = datetime(2010, 1, 1)
end_date = datetime(2025, 12, 31)

fig.suptitle('The AI Timeline: Research, Industry & Regulation (2010–2025)',
             fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=colors['text'],
             y=0.96, fontfamily='sans-serif')
fig.text(0.5, 0.925,
         'How breakthroughs cascade from labs to products to policy — and how ChatGPT compressed the cycle',
         ha='center', fontsize=13, color=colors['subtext'], fontstyle='italic',
         fontfamily='sans-serif')

chatgpt_date = datetime(2022, 11, 15)

for ax, (track_name, milestones, color) in zip(axes_tracks, track_data):
    ax.set_facecolor(colors['bg'])
    ax.set_xlim(start_date, end_date)

    ax.axvline(chatgpt_date, color=colors['chatgpt_line'], linewidth=1.5,
               linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

    ax.axhline(0, color=color, linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.35, zorder=2)

    alternating = True
    for i, m in enumerate(milestones):
        dt = parse_date(m['date'])
        sig = m['significance']
        ms = sig_sizes[sig]
        marker = sig_markers[sig]

        if sig == 'critical':
            y_offset = 0.55 if alternating else -0.55
        elif sig == 'high':
            y_offset = 0.42 if alternating else -0.42
        else:
            y_offset = 0.3 if alternating else -0.3

        ax.plot(dt, 0, marker=marker, markersize=ms, color=color,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=5,
                alpha=0.95 if sig == 'critical' else 0.8)

        fontsize = 8.0 if sig == 'critical' else 7.0 if sig == 'high' else 6.5
        fontweight = 'bold' if sig == 'critical' else 'semibold' if sig == 'high' else 'normal'

        if len(label_text) > 28:

            space_idx = label_text.rfind(' ', 0, mid + 5)

        va = 'bottom' if y_offset > 0 else 'top'
        text_y = y_offset

        ax.annotate(label_text, xy=(dt, 0), xytext=(0, y_offset * 72),
                    textcoords='offset points',
                    fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight,
                    color=colors['text'] if sig == 'critical' else colors['subtext'],
                    ha='center', va=va, zorder=6,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, alpha=0.35, lw=0.8)

    ax.set_yticks([])

ax_invest.plot(inv_years, inv_vals, color=colors['investment_line'], linewidth=2.5, zorder=4,
               marker='o', markersize=4, markerfacecolor=colors['investment_line'],
               markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8)

ax_invest.axvline(chatgpt_date, color=colors['chatgpt_line'], linewidth=1.5,
                  linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

ax_invest.set_ylim(0, 140)

ax_invest.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_invest.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_invest.spines['left'].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax_invest.spines['left'].set_color(colors['grid'])
ax_invest.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax_invest.spines['bottom'].set_color(colors['grid'])
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7.5, colors=colors['subtext'])
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9, colors=colors['subtext'])
ax_invest.grid(axis='y', color=colors['grid'], linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax_invest.grid(axis='x', color=colors['grid'], linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)

ax_invest.text(start_date, 0.88, '  GLOBAL AI INVESTMENT',

               transform=ax_invest.get_xaxis_transform(), va='top',
               bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
